children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
Which coils fit the Smok Pozz Pro replacement pods?
Only
Smok LP1 coils

fit the Smok Pozz Pro replacement pods. The Smok Pozz Pro kit ships with the 0.9 ohm LP1 mesh coil, and the 0.8 ohm LP1 mesh and 0.8 ohm LP1 DC MTL coils push into the same pod. Smok RPM, Nord and Novo 2 coils do not fit.
Do Smok Pozz Pro replacement pods come with a coil?
No.
Smok Pozz Pro replacement pods are sold empty, without a coil

, so order Smok LP1 coils with them. Each pod takes one push-fit LP1 coil, which you can move from the old pod if it still has life left. A three-pack of pods and a five-pack of coils is the usual pairing.
Do Smok Pozz Pro pods fit the Smok Pozz or Smok Pozz X?
No.
Smok Pozz Pro pods fit the Smok Pozz Pro only
. The original Smok Pozz uses a pod with a fixed built-in 0.8 ohm coil, and the Smok Pozz X is a 40W kit that takes Smok RPM coils. Check the name printed on the device before buying.
Why is my Smok Pozz Pro pod leaking?
A leaking Smok Pozz Pro pod usually means
the coil is not pushed fully home or the side stopper is not sealed
. Push the LP1 coil in until it stops, fill to just below the top, press the stopper flat and wipe the pod base and magnets dry before clicking it back in.
Why does my Smok Pozz Pro taste burnt?
A burnt taste from a Smok Pozz Pro pod means
the cotton in the LP1 coil is dry
. Prime a new coil with a few drops of e-liquid and wait 5 to 10 minutes, keep the pod above a quarter full, avoid chain vaping and use 50/50 or nic salt e-liquid, not thick shortfills.
How long does a Smok Pozz Pro replacement pod last?
A Smok Pozz Pro replacement pod typically
lasts through several coil changes

, so weeks rather than days. Replace the pod when the plastic turns cloudy, the silicone stopper no longer seals, the mouthpiece cracks or the magnets stop holding. The LP1 coil inside needs changing far more often, roughly every one to two weeks.
